local_availability: Only actually arrived descriptor events enable chunk inventories, offers and receipt; full read requires exact complete bytes and whole-content digest
durability: Private root/node-bound WAL store with atomic capacity reservation and chunk insertion; immutable descriptors and idempotent chunks; no transfer restart required after process death

bulk_rpc.payload_exchange: Bounded inventory and at most one response chunk
bulk_rpc.payload_push: At most one chunk into an already arrived descriptor
bulk_rpc.payload_state: Observer read-only availability and retained telemetry

transport: Same authenticated local TCP envelope, immutable membership and incoming/outgoing application partition gates as event transport; gossip rotating contacts or two-broker client fallback
accounting: Separate event and payload contacts; durable observed wire-byte prefixes and offered/validated chunks, including duplicates; not lossless crash or unique-delivery accounting
limitations: Trusted same-host group, no Byzantine producer identity
No TLS or multi-host failure proof
Logical payload reservation is not an exact physical disk cap
No eviction or continuous-stream fairness guarantee
Equal fanout is not matched resource capacity
